device_axis.note: Frame capture is the hottest call in the loop (twice per step plus once per recognition). MAA wins it by 36x and is therefore the default capture backend. Recognition is the opposite: the legacy fixed-ROI matcher is 3.3x faster than MAA's full-frame search at identical hits, so recognition is migrated per semantic against evidence, never wholesale. An earlier 5-sample probe reported 12.1 ms for MAA; the adapter initially failed to negotiate MuMu's extras and silently fell back to a 178 ms generic path, which is why the negotiated channel is now recorded on every adapter (see MaaExecutorAdapter.negotiated).
